dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior boundary of the dark band exhibits a broad, shallow U-shape across the dorsal midline without a distinct vertex point.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band is wide, occupying approximately 40% of the visible dorsal length between the neck and the lower back.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-orange pigmentation is present in the fur of the perianal and lower rump regions.
